title: Slide Settings: Fit, Trim, Loop and Volume | LayerCue from Zero, Episode 7
description:
Fix a slide before it goes out: what the control row changes (now only) versus Slide settings (saved), loading a slide without sending it, Scale (Fit, Fill, Stretch, Fit + blur for vertical video), Crop & fit, In and Out points, speed and repeat, slide volume, and To Screen to hold a video on a frame until its cue.
New here? Start with Episode 1: Meet LayerCue — The Main Window.
Recorded on LayerCue 0.9.12.
Manual: https://layercue.com/docs/slides/settings/
The narration is AI-generated and the music is built from GarageBand loops. The event, people and media in the demo are fictional.
playlist: LayerCue from Zero: Run Your First Show
